segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including winter-dry, high-desert-dry and dry-flaky presentations, report the cream relieves tightness and flakiness and is often reserved for cold weather or harsher climates.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive, rosacea-prone, eczema-prone or steroid-withdrawal skin report the cream soothes without burning or irritating, though a minority in this same group say fragrance triggered a reaction or breakout.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports it helps with dryness in winter without adding oiliness.
segments.mature: Reviewers identifying as middle-aged, mature or in their 60s report good hydration and improved skin texture, with one wishing it also contained SPF and another noting it helps skin that is drying further with age.
segments.oily: One reviewer describing dry-to-oily skin reports it keeps oiliness contained while still moisturizing, without greasiness.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers citing dryness or dehydration report strong, lasting hydration and relief from tightness and flaking, including in dry winter or desert climates; one 3-star review disputes this, saying it did not feel hydrating for her dry skin and became greasy after a few hours.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea, perioral dermatitis or general redness report the cream is soothing and reduces redness without burning; one reviewer wishes an SPF version were still sold to complement this effect.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe the product as restoring or supporting the skin barrier, including one recovering from topical steroid withdrawal who reports better moisture retention during flares.
concerns.spots: One reviewer applying the cream alongside a teenager's acne medication reports it eased dry, flaky side effects without irritation.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts, including two identical accounts of acne-prone, rosacea skin with no new breakouts; however, at least two reviewers report the product broke them out or caused an under-the-skin pimple, one attributing it to the fragrance.
concerns.aging: Reviewers describing mature or aging skin report improved texture, softness and hydration, with no negative comments specific to aging skin.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers concerned about oiliness report the cream hydrates without a greasy or oily look, and in one case helps refine pores and contain oil.

The tube does seem small, but you just need a tiny amount so this tube should last a while.

It's too old lady perfume-ish however, I will say, the fragrance doesn't last long. it goes away in a few minutes. I love the price for a product that works so well for my dry, dehydrated, sensitive skin. Any excess get rubs into my hands as well. Definitely a product I will be buying many more times.

It's an alright basic moisturizer. Looks nice when first applied but soon becomes greasy after an hour or 2 even on my dry skin and in colder weather. Fragrance is strong and unnecessary. Wish it was a richer texture - it's extremely light like a lotion and not what I'd expect from a rich cream. While my skin doesn't feel tight, I wouldn't necessarily call this product hydrating.
